## Preliminaries

```{r}

library(MASS)

#### Load functions
source("C:/Users/franc/OneDrive/Documenti/Francesco Lassi UniFi/Economics/Terzo anno Economics- Erasmus/Secondo semestre/Data Science for Economics/R/DS4E-Functions.R")

## Some functions

.character.2.factor <- function(data, exclude = NULL, include = NULL)
{
  #### Find character vars
  ind <- mapply(FUN = is.character, x = data)
  #### Exclude vars in 'exclude'
  ind <- ind & !( colnames(data) %in% exclude )
  #### Include vars in 'include'
  ind <- ind | colnames(data) %in% include
  #### Cycle across vars to convert
  ind <- which(ind)
  for (ind1 in ind)
  {
    data[, ind1] <- factor(data[, ind1])
  }
  #### Answer
  data
}

```

## Read data

```{r}
#### Original data
file <- "C:/Users/franc/OneDrive/Documenti/Francesco Lassi UniFi/Economics/Terzo anno Economics- Erasmus/Secondo semestre/Data Science for Economics/LassiFrancesco Data Report/Data-original.txt"
```

## Explore Data

### Synthetic Analysis

```{r}
dim(data)         ## rows x cols
colnames(data)    ## Names of the columns
head(data, 3)     ## First 3 lines
tail(data, 2)     ## Last 2 lines
str(data)         ## Structure

```

## Train/test sets split

```{r}

set.seed(1234)

n.test <- 0.20 * NROW(data)

ind <- sample(x = 1:NROW(data), size = n.test)

data.orig <- data                         
data.test <- data[ind, , drop = FALSE]    
data.train <- data[-ind, , drop = FALSE]  

cat("NROW(original)", NROW(data), "NROW(train)", NROW(data.train),
  "NROW(test)", NROW(data.test))
```

## GRADIENT BOOSTING

```{r}
formula <- VAR38 ~ VAR5 + VAR17 + VAR29 + VAR4 + VAR32 + VAR1 + VAR6 + VAR7 + VAR9 + VAR10 + VAR13 + VAR14 + VAR15 + VAR16 + VAR18 + VAR19 + VAR21 + VAR22 + VAR24 + VAR25 + VAR26 + VAR27 + VAR31 + VAR33 + VAR34 + VAR36 + VAR37
```

```{r}
set.seed(1000)
fit <- gbm(formula = formula, data = data.train, distribution = "bernoulli",
  var.monotone = NULL, train.fraction = 0.8, cv.folds = 10,
  interaction.depth = 3, n.minobsinnode = 10, n.trees = 2000, shrinkage = 0.05,
  bag.fraction = 0.5,
  keep.data = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
fit.gbm <- fit

class(fit.gbm)
typeof(fit.gbm)
names(fit.gbm)
```

```{r}
fit.gbm$initF                                     
fit.gbm[c("bag.fraction", "distribution", "interaction.depth",
  "n.minobsinnode", "nTrain", "n.trees", "train.fraction",
  "shrinkage")]

head(fit.gbm$fit)                                ## Fitted values (train data)
fitted <- predict(object = fit.gbm, newdata = data.train,
  n.trees = fit$n.trees, type = "response",
  single.tree = FALSE)
head(fitted)
```

```{r}
par(mar = c(4, 9, 0.5, 0.5))
plot(x = fit.gbm, i.var = "VAR29")                
plot(x = fit.gbm, i.var = "VAR4")
plot(x = fit.gbm, i.var = "VAR5")
plot(x = fit.gbm, i.var = "VAR17")
```

## Clues to optimize: the error analysis

```{r}
par(mar = c(2, 2, 0.5, 0.5))
head(fit.gbm$train.error)
plot(x = fit.gbm$train.error, xlab = "Iteration", ylab = "Cross Entropy", type = "l")
head(fit.gbm$valid.error)
lines(x = fit.gbm$valid.error, xlab = "Iteration", type = "l", col = "red")
head(fit.gbm$cv.error)
lines(x = fit.gbm$cv.error, xlab = "Iteration", type = "l", col = "green")
abline(v = which.min(fit.gbm$cv.error), col = "blue", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
```

```{r}
n.trees.best <- gbm.perf(object = fit.gbm,
  plot.it = TRUE, oobag.curve = FALSE, overlay = FALSE,
  method = "cv")
legend(x = "topright",
  legend = c("Train error", "Validation error", "CV error", "Best CV n.trees choice"),
  col = c("black", "red", "green", "blue"),
  lty = c(1, 1, 1, 2), lwd = c(1, 1, 1, 2),
  fill = NULL, border = "white", pch = NULL, bty = "o")
n.trees.best
n.trees.best1 <- n.trees.best
```

```{r}
cat("train: min error = ", min(fit.gbm$train.error), ", n.trees = ",
  which.min(fit.gbm$train.error), sep = "")
cat("validation: min error = ", min(fit.gbm$valid.error), ", n.trees = ",
  which.min(fit.gbm$valid.error), sep = "")
cat("CV: min error = ", min(fit.gbm$cv.error), ", n.trees = ",
  which.min(fit.gbm$cv.error), sep = "")
```

## Model perfomance evaluation (probaility based)

```{r}
data <- data.test
y <- data$VAR38

fit.stats <- rbind(
  GBM = .fit.stats.bin(fit = fit.gbm, y = y, x = data, n.trees = n.trees.best1))
fit.stats
```

## Model performance evaluation: ROC curve

```{r}

data <- data.test
y <- data$VAR38

pred.gbm <- predict(object = fit.gbm, newdata = data,
  n.trees = n.trees.best1, type = "response",
  single.tree = FALSE)
pred <- cbind(pred.gbm)

roc <- roc.plot(x = y, pred = pred,
  xlab = "False Positive Rate", ylab = "True Positive Rate",
  show.thres = FALSE, legend = TRUE, leg.text = c("GBM"))
roc$roc.vol
```
